The supplied page 23 locates this section in the published article, but does not identify a particular interaction; the retrieved author manuscript does not print a separate statistic for the CS × Group or CS × Block × Group extinction interaction.

replication.target_description: Single experiment (input study 1): continuous conditional-stimulus valence, all participants in control, instruction/electrode-on and instruction/electrode-off groups; CS × Phase × Group interaction comparing last acquisition trial with first extinction trial.

notes: Both titles verified against references using university-repository Figshare metadata and manuscript title pages. Cached full author manuscripts, not final journal PDFs; locations therefore give manuscript PDF/printed page numbers. Original test ambiguity retained: main effects of CS measure persistent differential valence, not the instruction effect, and the largest reported nonsignificant interactions are not substitutes for an unprinted CS × Group or CS × Block × Group statistic. No metric conversion performed. The original manuscript reports the full sample including an unaware participant; final-publication sample/statistics cannot be assumed identical. Acquisition: DOI landing pages, Unpaywall and OpenAlex identified Curtin repository files; old repository endpoints blocked/empty; migrated Curtin Figshare yielded full PDFs. An untargeted title search returned unsolicited FORRT search-result snippets; no FORRT page was opened, and no values or verdicts were extracted from those snippets. All extraction evidence above comes from the cached primary manuscripts.
